purpose: Define the single native seam that future traversal abilities and Blueprint gates must use.

capability_query_seam.module_dependency_rule: BS_GodFile must not depend on MelodiaWardrobe; MelodiaWardrobe already depends on BS_GodFile, so use a module-neutral provider/registry or an explicit Blueprint bridge

required_future_native_contract.context_policy: evaluate before request and after every context/load transition
required_future_native_contract.capability_gate_policy: resolve stable capability identity and context before movement transition; missing or unavailable capability rejects without mutation
required_future_native_contract.reset_policy: restore grounded state without duplicating input-context ownership
required_future_native_contract.blueprint_access: BlueprintCallable request plus BlueprintPure state/result queries

forbidden_operations: direct input-context stack ownership for traversal

verification_before_promotion: native API compiles and is Blueprint-visible
accepted request produces one deterministic state transition
blocked context produces a stable reason and no movement mutation
interrupt/load reset returns to grounded state
gate observes the same state without owning it
